QUOTE: The deny list is checked again in `ServerManager::execute`, after approval. It wins over `auto_approve` and over the allow list, so a denied tool never reaches the server.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer places a deny check in ServerManager::execute, but it also lists many other blocking checks (schema, tier, duplicate, approval default-deny, anti-spiral). It never concludes that the deny list is the only thing that blocks execution there.
